name: Northern Lights #5 x Haze
summary: Northern Lights #5 x Haze is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] first bred by Nevil Schoenmakers's The Seed Bank from [[northern-lights-5|Northern Lights #5]] and [[haze|Haze]], and released around 1989. [[breeder:Sensi Seeds]] later reworked the line and now sells it as roughly 70% sativa. It won the 1990 Cannabis Cup in the sativa category.

sources.title: Northern Lights #5 x Haze
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms Sensi Seeds developed the cross and gives roughly 70% sativa. Does not itself mention the Seed Bank / Nevil origin or the 1989 date, which come from SeedFinder and Wikipedia.
